howItWorks.subtitle: From a WhatsApp message to a delivered product and payout — every step runs on Jovi Mall automatically.

flow.step1Desc: No app download. No account creation. Just a chat.
flow.step2Desc: Our engine understands intent and suggests the perfect match.
flow.step3Desc: Customer confirms and pays — all within WhatsApp.
flow.step4Desc: Smart dispatch routes the order to the nearest agent.
flow.step5Desc: Real-time tracking. Confirmed delivery. Happy customer.

vendor.subtitle: Your business doesn't need a website, an app, or a tech team. Just upload your catalog and let our AI handle the rest — from discovery to delivery.

africaFirst.subtitle: We didn't just repackage a Western ecommerce model. Jovi Mall is built from the ground up for mobile-dominant, WhatsApp-native, data-conscious shoppers and businesses.

features.mobileDesc: Every pixel optimized for the phones people actually use — from entry-level Infinix to flagship Samsung.
features.whatsappDesc: No downloads, no logins. Commerce where 2+ billion people already spend their day.
features.dataDesc: Built to work on 2G, 3G, and spotty connections. Commerce that doesn't stop when the signal drops.

phone.chat2AI: Here are 5 perfect gifts under ₦15k — featuring top sellers! 🎉

trust.subtitle: Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for the speed and scale of modern commerce — without the enterprise complexity.

features.aiDesc: Our recommendation engine understands context, intent, and purchase history to surface the right product at the right time.
